name: List All Leads
description: Returns all leads that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by lead Id. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by property Id associated with the lead.

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter leads last updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Page size for pagination. Default is 100.

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of lead objects meeting the filter criteria

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the lead

responseFields.name: data[].AdditionalOccupants
responseFields.description: The number of other potential occupants of the residency

responseFields.name: data[].AssignedUserId
responseFields.description: The AppFolio Property Manager user responsible for the lead. Reference the Users endpoint for any necessary associations.

responseFields.name: data[].Bathrooms
responseFields.description: The number of desired bathrooms

responseFields.name: data[].Bedrooms
responseFields.description: The number of desired bedrooms

responseFields.name: data[].CreatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the lead was created

responseFields.name: data[].CreditScore
responseFields.description: The self-reported credit score of the interested party

responseFields.name: data[].DesiredMoveIn
responseFields.description: The date the prospective resident desires to move in

responseFields.name: data[].Duplicate
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the lead is a duplicate of an existing lead. Leads are marked as duplicates if a lead was submitted from a party with the same contact information (phone number or email) that is already associated with a lead with the same PropertyId.

responseFields.name: data[].OriginalLeadId
responseFields.description: ID of the existing lead this lead duplicates. The ID attribute of the newly created lead will be distinct from its duplicate.

responseFields.name: data[].Email
responseFields.description: The email address of the interested person

responseFields.name: data[].FirstName
responseFields.description: The first name of the interested person

responseFields.name: data[].GuestCardId
responseFields.description: The unique identifier of the Guest Card, which may include multiple leads

responseFields.name: data[].HasCats
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the interested person has cat(s)

responseFields.name: data[].HasDogs
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the interested person has dog(s)

responseFields.name: data[].HasOtherPet
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the interested person has other pet(s)

responseFields.name: data[].InactiveReason
responseFields.description: The reason why the lead was marked inactive

responseFields.name: data[].LastName
responseFields.description: The last name of the interested person

responseFields.name: data[].Link
responseFields.description: A link to the lead page in the AppFolio Property Manager

responseFields.name: data[].MaxRent
responseFields.description: The max amount the interested person is willing to pay monthly for rent

responseFields.name: data[].Messages
responseFields.description: Array of objects representing messages sent about a lead

responseFields.name: data[].MiddleInitial
responseFields.description: The middle initial of the interested person

responseFields.name: data[].MonthlyIncome
responseFields.description: The self-reported monthly income of the interested person

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumber
responseFields.description: The phone number of the interested person

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the lead

responseFields.name: data[].RentalApplicationId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the rental application associated with the lead

responseFields.name: data[].RentalApplicationGroupId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the rental application group id associated with the lead if they applied as a group

responseFields.name: data[].Source
responseFields.description: The mechanism through which this lead was submitted

responseFields.name: data[].Status
responseFields.description: Indicates the current phase of engagement with a prospective resident

responseFields.name: data[].UnitIds
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit(s) that the interested party is interested in

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the lead was last updated

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
